reviews.text: I have recently started using their services, and all the staff are very friendly both on the phone and in person, and my dog ​​doesn't bark when I take him there (he used to bark a lot when I took him there lol), so I feel like I am being treated well. I am also satisfied with the results, and I feel safe here, so I have booked a hotel. I also look forward to the photos they take every time, and I set them as my smartphone wallpaper every month.

I use their services for both of my cats. It's so easy to book appointments, which is a great help.

They carefully check the areas to be trimmed beforehand and are considerate of my cats' sensitivity to noise, so I feel completely at ease leaving them in their care. I'm always impressed by how fluffy and silky their fur is afterwards.

They also take lots of photos, which I look forward to every time.

We've been using their services for almost four years now.

We never had our first dog groomed, but we've been using their services ever since our second dog arrived. They carefully check our dog's health and skin condition during grooming, and they keep track of weight changes, which is incredibly helpful for managing her health. Her skin condition has also improved. They always take adorable photos at the end of the day, and everyone around us compliments them. The background for the photos is also beautifully set up each month, which is something that pet owners really look forward to. We feel completely at ease leaving our dog in their care, so we look forward to continuing to use their services.
